_readme: Copy this file to harness/athlete.json and fill it in. athlete.json is gitignored — it holds your race, your target and your measured physiological values. Everything here feeds harness/generate_plan.py.
_measured: The next four should be MEASURED, not estimated. lthr and threshold_pace come from a 30-minute time trial or your watch's lactate-threshold test; the zones are built from lthr, never from hr_max.
_note: hr_max is recorded for reference only — the plan's zones are derived from lthr, because an estimated maximum heart rate is not a usable basis for training zones.
